serverInfo.name: dveracity-semantic
serverInfo.description: Check sustainability data before you rely on it. Validate emissions records against the Open Footprint standard, evaluate EU CBAM records and declarations against approved regulatory policies, map ERP and supplier fields onto Open Footprint, and query verified oil-and-gas emissions data (PPDM, OGMP 2.0 methane). Model lookups are free; validation and queries cost 1 credit ($0.01). Every result lists which checks ran and which did not.
